name: Feature / content request
about: Propose a new task, interaction, or capability
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What are you proposing?

A clear description of the new task, interaction, mechanic, or tool.

## Why does it fit?

How does it serve the piece — the fiction, the hostile-dashboard concept, or the
engineering? (If it is purely content, note the department it belongs to.)

## Would it be content or machinery?

- [ ] New **task** (adds to the `TASKS` corpus in `src/data/tasks.ts`)
- [ ] New **interaction** (a bespoke task panel in `App.tsx`)
- [ ] New **system** (audio, persistence, shaders, MIDI, etc.)

## Scope

Describe the minimal version and any stretch goals. Smaller is better — the
corpus is intentionally over-scoped and over-budget; the best proposals add one
precise thing.

## Notes

Mention if this should stay deliberately strange, impossible, or procedurally
inaccurate (the system celebrates that).
